verdict: Cost per lead doubled this week — we're on it now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 178 leads at $2.14 each, which is a healthy baseline — but the most recent week tells a different story. Spend rose 43% while leads fell 32%, pushing this week's cost per lead up 111% against the prior week. November 8 recorded zero leads on $42.95 in spend, which confirmed a signal break in paid search, not just normal variance. Ad campaigns are being reviewed and adjusted this week to restore efficiency before the problem compounds. Expect cost per lead to stabilize as those changes take effect; we'll flag immediately if they don't.
